title: C++ Systems & Low-Level Foundations
description: Master modern C++20/23, RAII, memory layout, cache locality, SIMD intrinsics, templates, and zero-cost abstractions.
prerequisites: Solid programming foundations in any imperative language

title: Rust Core: Memory Safety & Systems Concurrency
description: Deep dive into ownership, borrow checker internals, lifetimes, fearless concurrency, Unsafe Rust, and atomics.

title: WebCore: Browser Engine Internals & Rendering Pipelines
description: Understand how Chromium and WebKit parse HTML/CSS, build the DOM & Render Tree, calculate layouts, and execute compositor passes.

title: High Performance Browser Networking
description: TCP slow start, TLS 1.3 0-RTT, HTTP/2 multiplexing, HTTP/3 QUIC packet frames, and low-latency WebRTC architectures.

title: Distributed Databases & Storage Engine Design
description: Build storage engines from scratch: LSM-trees, B+Trees, Write-Ahead Logs, Raft consensus, and MVCC concurrency.
prerequisites: Data structures and basic C++ or Go

title: V8 Engine Internals & JavaScript Runtimes
description: From source code to machine code: Ignition bytecode, TurboFan JIT optimizations, inline caches, and the Libuv event loop.

title: Modern Framework Architecture: Signals to Virtual DOM
description: Deconstruct React Fiber, Vue Reactivity, and Solid/Svelte reactive signal graphs by building your own micro-framework.

title: High-Scale Distributed APIs & Microservices
description: Protobuf schema serialization, bidirectional gRPC streaming, GraphQL AST compilation, token bucket rate limiting, and OpenTelemetry.

title: Bare-Metal Embedded Systems & RTOS
description: Direct register manipulation on ARM Cortex-M, interrupt handlers, DMA transfers, SPI/I2C/UART protocols, and FreeRTOS task scheduling.

title: Enterprise Systems & Cloud-Native Architecture
description: Hexagonal Architecture, CQRS, Event Sourcing, Domain-Driven Design, Kubernetes operator patterns, and zero-trust security.

title: Neural Foundations & Transformer Architectures
description: Mathematical foundations of deep learning, multi-head self-attention, FlashAttention-2, KV-Cache optimization, and CUDA kernels.

title: Interactive Neural Computation & WebGPU Lab
description: Hands-on matrix calculus, training toy networks in WebGPU, hyperparameter tuning, and backpropagation visualization in the browser.

title: High-Performance Python & Vectorized Computing
description: Python 3.13 free-threaded GIL elimination, SIMD memory alignment with NumPy & Polars, C-extensions, and parallel multiprocessing.

title: GPU-Accelerated CSS & Modern Layout Engines
description: Browser compositing layers, CSS will-change optimizations, Houdini Paint Worklets, subpixel rendering, and fluid fluid typography.

title: Quantum Computing & Quantum Algorithm Design
description: Qubit state vectors, Bloch sphere representation, Quantum Gates, Superposition, Entanglement, Shor's & Grover's algorithms.

title: Binary Exploitation & Systems Security
description: Ghidra disassembly, stack smashing, ROP chain construction, ASLR/DEP bypasses, kernel exploitation, and secure systems design.

title: High-Scale Site Reliability & Linux eBPF
description: Linux kernel observability with eBPF, BGP Anycast routing, Chaos Engineering, Envoy proxy filters, and multi-region resilience.

title: Deep Consensus: Raft, Paxos & Byzantine Fault Tolerance
description: Atomic broadcast, Paxos synod proofs, Multi-Raft log replication, PBFT consensus under adversarial network conditions.
